entries.title: Vice Got a Price!
entries.walkthrough: This is the capstone: it unlocks on its own the moment the other 54 trophies are all on your account. There is nothing separate to perform, so treat the rest of this atlas as its real requirement list and use the checklist counter as its progress meter.

entries.title: Just Like Paradise
entries.walkthrough: Play through Gone Fishing, the introductory mission the campaign opens with. Simply reach its end cutscene and the trophy registers; no optional objective inside the mission affects it.

entries.title: Paradise Lost
entries.walkthrough: Work through every main mission grouped under Chapter 1 in order. The trophy lands when the chapter's closing mission wraps up, so just keep following the story markers until the chapter banner appears.

entries.title: T**s Ass Drug Money
entries.walkthrough: Finish all of the Chapter 2 story missions in sequence. Nothing here is optional for progression, so steady story play is the whole method; the award fires at the chapter finale.

entries.title: Vice City, Baby!
entries.walkthrough: Clear the Chapter 3 mission chain from its first job to its finale. Keep pushing the main thread whenever you log in and this will pop naturally at the chapter's end.

entries.title: Top Of The World, Ma
entries.walkthrough: Complete each Chapter 4 story mission. As with the earlier chapters, the trophy is tied to finishing the block rather than to any score or medal, so completion alone is enough.

entries.title: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
entries.walkthrough: Reach and finish the campaign's last mission. This is one of only two gold trophies on the list, and it marks the point where free-roam clean-up for the 100 percent push becomes much easier to organise.

entries.title: Trust
entries.walkthrough: Play the story mission called Breakfast Run through to its conclusion. It sits on the main path, so you will meet it by following the campaign; finishing the mission is the only condition.

entries.title: Break the Bank
entries.walkthrough: Complete The Cartel Heist, a set-piece story mission. Prepare a decent loadout before starting, then simply survive the job and reach its closing scene to bank the trophy.

entries.title: Family Matters
entries.walkthrough: Finish the story mission Child's Play. It is part of the campaign sequence, so progress the main thread until it appears and play it to the end.

entries.title: DWNFALL
entries.walkthrough: Complete the Headliners story mission when the campaign offers it. No side condition is attached; reaching the mission's end screen is sufficient.

entries.title: Hi-Jacked
entries.walkthrough: Play VCIA Takedown, the airport-authority story job, through to completion. Follow the mission objectives as presented and the trophy unlocks at the debrief.

entries.title: Snow Storm
entries.walkthrough: Finish Operation Savage Glory on the story path. Treat it as a standard campaign mission: complete every objective stage and the award follows automatically.

entries.title: A Long Road
entries.walkthrough: Push the in-game completion statistic all the way to 100 percent. This gold is the marathon of the list: story, stranger strands, activities, collectibles and challenges all feed the percentage, so use the roadmap view and clear one family at a time, checking the counter after each block.

entries.title: Cunning Stunts
entries.walkthrough: Land 250 registered stunts across Leonida. Work district by district in a sturdy, fast car or bike, hitting ramps and jumps you pass during other clean-up, and keep a rough tally in the tracker so the silver does not become an end-game surprise.

entries.blurb: Try each type of activity once.
entries.title: Master of None
entries.walkthrough: Sample every one of the nine activity types at least once. This is a sampler trophy: start each activity once rather than mastering it, and tick the types off in the notes field of your tracker as you go.

entries.blurb: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
entries.title: The Shootist
entries.walkthrough: Earn gold in all 42 Shooting Range challenges. Learn each range's target pattern with a few practice runs, upgrade accuracy stats first if the game offers it, and clear the challenges range by range instead of hopping between them.

entries.blurb: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
entries.title: Top Fun
entries.walkthrough: Win the Top Fun drone race at each of the 14 locations. A win at one spot does not carry to the next, so tour the map venue by venue and retry immediately after a loss while the course is still fresh in your head.

entries.title: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
entries.walkthrough: Win twenty distinct races; re-winning a race you already won does not add to the count. Spread the wins across the race catalogue, favour short events early on, and mark each won event in the tracker so you never waste time repeating one.

entries.title: Baited My Tackle
entries.blurb: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
entries.walkthrough: Take on Cal's fishing challenge and out-catch him. Learn the reeling rhythm on ordinary fish first, then accept the challenge once you are comfortable; a single victory is all this trophy asks for.

entries.title: Stick Fiddler
entries.walkthrough: Finish one arcade game from start to completion at any cabinet you find. Pick the shortest cabinet game on offer and play it through instead of quitting mid-run; the trophy pops at its end screen.

entries.title: Road to Rehabilitation
entries.blurb: Complete the final mission for Andy.
entries.walkthrough: Follow Andy's strand of side missions all the way to his final job and complete that job. Strands unlock in stages, so return to Andy whenever his marker reappears between story missions.

entries.title: This Was No Boat Accident
entries.blurb: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
entries.walkthrough: Work through Kenton's side missions until his concluding job appears, then finish that last one. Keep his strand moving alongside the campaign so its finale is ready well before your end-game clean-up.

entries.title: The Lone Rider
entries.blurb: Complete the final mission for Billy.
entries.walkthrough: Complete Billy's side-mission chain including its final entry. The trophy is awarded for the strand's last mission specifically, not for the earlier jobs, so keep going until the strand formally closes.

entries.title: Strangers & Freaks
entries.blurb: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
entries.walkthrough: Finish eight full stranger mission strands anywhere in Leonida. The named-contact trophies elsewhere in this atlas already cover several strands, so count those in, then pick the shortest remaining strands to reach eight complete ones for this silver.

entries.title: Supply & Demand
entries.blurb: Complete the final mission for Randy.
entries.walkthrough: See Randy's side strand through to its final mission and complete it. Check back with him after major story beats, since strand stages tend to unlock as the campaign advances.

entries.title: Spin On This!
entries.blurb: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
entries.walkthrough: Finish Tyrone's chain of side jobs, ending with his final mission. The trophy triggers only on that concluding job, so keep accepting his work until the strand closes.

entries.title: Positive Mental Attitude
entries.blurb: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
entries.walkthrough: Visit all 18 meditation spots scattered over Leonida and meditate at each one. Combine the tour with exploration for The Goodtime State, and tick the spots off region by region so none is left hiding at the end.

entries.title: Fair Game
entries.blurb: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
entries.walkthrough: Accept Bret's hunting request and bring down the unique animal it names. Prepare a suitable long-range weapon before you start tracking, and complete the hunt in one outing so the objective cannot stall.

entries.title: Don't Touch My Deck
entries.walkthrough: Assemble three complete collectible card sets. Focus on one set at a time and sweep its locations in a single route; partial sets earn nothing, so finished sets, not raw card count, are the metric that matters for this silver.

entries.title: You WAiNKer!
entries.walkthrough: Use the WAiNK It action at 100 different locations. This is a pure coverage grind: work district by district while doing other clean-up, and let the atlas counter reassure you the total is climbing even when a session only adds a few.

entries.title: One Last Thing
entries.walkthrough: Complete any 50 challenges from the challenge pool. Favour short, repeatable ones that match how you already play, and dip into the challenge list between bigger objectives so the fifty accumulate quietly in the background.

entries.title: Hot Together
entries.blurb: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
entries.walkthrough: While your partner is with you, raise a four-star wanted level, then break line of sight and stay hidden until the stars drain away completely. A fast car and a pre-planned hiding route through tunnels, alleys or off-road cuts makes the escape far more reliable.

entries.title: Retail Therapy
entries.blurb: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
entries.walkthrough: With your partner present, rob three shops in one unbroken chain while keeping a wanted level active the whole time. Plot three nearby shops before starting, move fast between them, and never hide long enough for the wanted level to drop mid-chain.

entries.title: Whip It Good
entries.walkthrough: Discover one hundred different vehicles, which generally means getting in and driving models you have not used before. Wealthy districts, ports and airfields concentrate unusual models, so detour through them whenever you pass.

entries.title: Gunslinger
entries.blurb: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
entries.walkthrough: During one activation of Combat Focus, drop five enemies before the effect ends. Set the moment up deliberately: trigger it in a crowded close-range firefight with a full magazine and prioritise the nearest targets first.

entries.title: Catch Me If You Can
entries.blurb: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
entries.phase: One-off moment - keep a spare save
entries.walkthrough: At VCIA, leave in a way the airport never scheduled, in practice by taking an aircraft out without clearance. This atlas flags it as missable because it is tied to one specific place-and-moment stunt; keep a manual save from before your airport story beats so you can retry freely if the first attempt does not register.

entries.title: Challenging Tank
entries.walkthrough: This one revolves around Rhinos, the game's tanks: get involved with one when the opportunity presents itself, whether that means surviving an encounter or taking the fight to it. Heavy weaponry and distance are your friends; do not trade shots at close range.

entries.title: Sneakthief
entries.blurb: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
entries.walkthrough: Rob a jewelry store while staying completely undetected from entry to exit. Scout the store layout first, move quietly, avoid cameras and witnesses, and leave by the least-watched exit; if you are spotted, reload and refine the route rather than forcing it.

entries.title: Maximum Withdrawal
entries.walkthrough: Rob five bank vaults and escape cleanly after each one. Treat every vault as a two-part job: a fast, rehearsed grab inside, and a planned getaway route outside. Repeating a favourite vault layout is fine as long as each robbery ends with a successful escape.

entries.title: A Classic Blitz Play
entries.blurb: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
entries.walkthrough: Hit an armored truck, take its cargo and get away. Stop the truck somewhere with a clear exit route, work quickly once it is open, and switch vehicles during the escape to break the trail.

entries.title: The Goodtime State
entries.walkthrough: Explore all 52 areas of Leonida so the whole map is uncovered. Ride along coastlines and through inland pockets you normally skip, and pair the sweep with the meditation spots and WAiNK locations so one long tour clears several trophies at once.

entries.title: Pest Control
entries.blurb: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
entries.walkthrough: Rob one illegal operation run by each of the nine gangs. Keep a written list of the gangs you have already hit in the tracker notes; the last gangs are easy to forget, and a checklist prevents a frustrating recount at the end.

entries.title: In The Beginning…
entries.blurb: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
entries.phase: Quiet moment - keep a spare save
entries.walkthrough: Go to Ocean Beach and have a cocktail somewhere with a view. This atlas flags it as missable because it reads as a one-scene moment rather than a repeatable activity; keep a spare save from your Ocean Beach story visits so you can return and savour it if you rushed past the first time.

entries.title: Capital Offense
entries.blurb: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
entries.phase: One-off stunt - keep a spare save
entries.walkthrough: Inside a vehicle showroom, get into a car and drive it out through the glass in true series tradition. Flagged missable here because the stunt belongs to a specific set-piece opportunity; if the moment passes during a mission, a spare save lets you replay it without restarting the campaign.

entries.title: Let’s Go Bowling
entries.blurb: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
entries.walkthrough: Visit the Kolt and Associates bowling alley and complete the follow-through the trophy describes there. It is a short leisure stop rather than a skill test, so drop in whenever you are passing that part of the map.

entries.title: Personal Best
entries.phase: Partner moment - keep a spare save
entries.walkthrough: The official wording points at a feel-good partnership moment with broad appeal, most plausibly a shared activity or photo-worthy beat with your partner. Because its trigger reads as a specific story-side moment, this atlas flags it missable: keep rotating manual saves during partner-heavy chapters so you can revisit the beat if it slips by unmarked.

entries.title: Actions Speak Louder
entries.walkthrough: This trophy is about the choices you make, for better or worse, and progress trackers count choices in the hundreds, up to 500. Make decisions deliberately whenever the game offers them instead of skipping through, and keep branching saves at big decision points; flagged missable because a choice once made cannot be un-made on the same save.

entries.title: Bad Luck, I Guess
entries.phase: Retry moment - keep a spare save
entries.walkthrough: The wording describes failing at something and succeeding on the second attempt. When a scripted attempt goes wrong, resist the urge to reload instantly; play the retry the game offers and let the second-time success happen naturally. Flagged missable because it depends on a fail-then-retry sequence that a perfect first run may skip.

entries.title: The Truth Is Out There
entries.phase: Strange encounter - keep a spare save
entries.walkthrough: Witness one of Leonida's strange, unexplained happenings. Explore odd corners of the map at night and investigate anything that looks deliberately out of place. Flagged missable in this atlas because scripted oddities tend to be one-time encounters; a spare save from rural exploration sessions is cheap insurance.

entries.title: Ten Pin
entries.blurb: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
entries.walkthrough: While driving, knock a pedestrian down with a melee drive-by strike rather than with the vehicle itself. Pick a quiet street, line up a single target at low speed, and time the swing as you pass; it may take a few passes to judge the reach.

entries.title: Dime on the Dollar
entries.blurb: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
entries.walkthrough: Launder a cumulative quarter of a million dollars in marked bills through your contacts. Feed bills into the laundering route whenever you hold them instead of stockpiling, and let the total build alongside your other income work.

entries.title: Treat Yo Self
entries.walkthrough: Spend a cumulative one hundred thousand dollars across the game's shops. Vehicles, weapons, clothing and property dressing all chip away at it; there is no need to splurge at once, but do not hoard cash either, since normal play spending counts.

entries.title: Little Boxes
entries.walkthrough: Buy all eight garage properties on the map. Save toward them during the money grinds above, then do one purchasing tour at the end; owning every garage also gives you storage that makes vehicle discovery for Whip It Good easier.

entries.title: On the Spot
entries.blurb: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
entries.walkthrough: Register ten vehicles to the Scooter Bros app. Whenever you acquire a vehicle you intend to keep, register it straight away instead of batching the job later; ten registrations accumulate quickly once it becomes a habit.
